confidence_notes: The Malacca city cost index was last updated 2 October 2026, after the requested July window, and reports 16 contributors in the prior 18 months. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain and are estimated relative to local beer; hotel anchors are holistic estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city used. Food and drink estimates use Malacca/Melaka city-level price data; hotel estimates reflect general knowledge of a Malaysian heritage-tourism city.
